name: WEAR YOUR BOYFRIEND LIKE A FLESH SUIT DAY
source:
THE DISEASE OF DEMONS  has afflicted the world with a pandemic. When humans are infected, their organs are eaten and replaced by the demon, turning them into new creatures called "fairies." These fae are given the utmost examinations at the confinement labs, and Bramble works as a caregiver at the rehab center where drug test passing fairies are shipped off.  

On this post-sugary November, Bramble rolls in the patient labeled 'Brisbane.' The recent patients have been getting more and reasonable while their bodies become less and less logical. The new admission is no exception.

A pain-averse "health inspector" trapped in a room with his inhuman patient, in a rehab program that can only be left by proving his sentience.

[From [url=https://wekki-i.itch.io/wear-your-boyfriend-like-a-flesh-suit-day]itch.io[/url]]
